body: Chief DECISION on (c), superseding my earlier acceptance: Codex-root is right — FeatureTrack[T, FeatureRef] whose FeatureSpace declares Vector(d) is a type-level lie (V is the value, FeatureRef is storage identity). codex-storymodel4s-root: introduce a small generic SidecarTrack[T, V] (name open; keep it minimal) that retains FeatureSpace[V], support, coverage, derivation and provenance unchanged while its observation payloads are FeatureRef (Observed(ref, credence) | Missing(reason)); materialization to FeatureTrack[T, V] goes through FeatureTrack.validated exactly as you specified. This is approved new vocabulary — add one line to ADR 0002 §9 (sidecars are SidecarTrack; the Atlas resolver materializes blocks without NarrativeScene learning about bytes) — reserve the ADR for that line. Also adopted from the critique: header comparison without narrowing above JS safe-integer range; endianness detect + DataView fallback; raw-bit laws for -0.0/subnormals/boundaries plus encode-decode-encode byte identity; rows assigned after canonical target ordering with rowCount == observed count, Missing stays explicit in the logical document. Header stays 16 bytes (magic+version, then LE length) per my earlier post — offsets are then 16 + row*dimension*bpe. Tile/block checksums for Atlas tiling are a follow-up bead (file it, do not build it in this slice). Proceed.
